note: Private exhibit material stays OUTSIDE public git: this manifest references the local capture by path; the runner retains its bytes in the run CAS (run root is outside the repo). Coverage is the preamble-through-account-terms slice; the whole capture remains navigable.

source.name: Coinbase User Agreement (2026-08-01 wayback fulltext)

slice.endMarker: Any attempted transactions in such items will result in loss of the item.
slice.note: The range runs from beginMarker through the last endMarker found within endOffsetFromBegin characters. A bare character count cut the next sentence in half ("You acknowledge and agree that other than as set forth in this"), and a parser reads half a sentence as if it were whole.

source.preambleNote: Bounded ranges MUST include the party-definition preamble; without the alias antecedent, 'We may...' reads as epistemic possibility instead of deontic permission.

questionFamilies.clauseMarker: We may amend or modify this Agreement

amend_right.question: Does this clause give Coinbase the right to change the agreement?

reading.question: What kind of modality does this clause express?
options: deontic-permission: The platform is permitted to amend the agreement.
epistemic-possibility: Amendment is merely described as possible.
obligation: The platform must amend the agreement.

expected.note: Reference observations from the 2026-11-19 LCNC demo run on the TRUE amendment clause (marker+rule selected). The model affirms the amendment right (noul 0.969) yet reads the modality as obligation over permission, diverging from Stanza's permission reading: proposals must not auto-admit. Earlier scratch numbers (noul~0.36) were the 'governs...may be offered' sentence mislabeled as amendment; see CORRECTION.md in the scratch run dir.

remedy.question: According to this clause, what is the user's sole remedy if they reject a modification?
options: terminate-and-close: End use of the Services and close the account.
arbitration: Submit the dispute to binding arbitration.
refund: Demand a refund of fees.
none: The clause does not state a remedy.

is_conditional.question: Does this clause state a condition with a consequence for the user?

expected.note: Correct option with substantial open-set null mass; null is never renormalized away.
